blocks.text: IN PROPHECY— This planet between now and 1999-2000, ‘‘will our type of civilization still exist or will a new age be ushered in?’’ — Jesus own words were, — ‘‘this generation shall not pass away till all these things be fulfilled!’’ (Matt. 24:34) — ‘‘He gave a clue; the climax is to come in our time! — With Israel already in her homeland all signs indicate this century will see the close out! — Some scientists even believe doomsday is just around the corner!’’ — ‘‘According to Bible cycles the next decade will complete 6,000 years of mans week! — Surely our days are numbered and soon we shall fly away!’’ — “‘I have foreseen great disaster and tribulation sweeping the globe before the turn of this century! — The fingers of the cosmic clock are casting shadows pointing to the midnight hour! Soon millions of God’s beloved will vanish ‘‘translation!’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘The future will speak boldly! The creeping electronic enslavement and computer control of the 90’s will lead to the apocalyptic Scriptures foretold in Rev. 13! — We will soon see the gods of this world bringing forth a super religion and government deceiving the masses! — A super empire headed up by Satan’s master of deception! Forerunning this will be all types of lying signs and wonders! Even now visions of the Virgin Mary are being seen everywhere according to accounts!’’ — ‘‘She says, she shall bring peace to the people and then peace to the world — But we know only Jesus will do this, after the coming of Armageddon! Also, you will see in the 90s all type of occurrences, the occult, sorcery, and witchcraft. Never in all history will mankind see what is just ahead! — A supernatural force will bring forth spellbinders, magic, illusions and subtle wizards even using some of the Scriptures!’’ — ‘‘The dark hours of the 90s will finally even surpass the evil powers that opposed Moses in His day!’’ — ‘‘This will forerun and blend into the coming system; for she is the mistress of witchcraft! (Rev. chap. 17)

THE HOUR GLASS OF PROPHETIC TIME— ‘‘A world leader will soon rise and make a covenant with Israel.’ — ‘‘Also Mary worship blended with Christ will take place even in the USA! — The anti-Christ, later will do away with the Jewish sacrifice (in Temple) — He will do away with the Christ and Mary worship and claim that he alone is to be worshiped as God!’’ (II Thess. 2:4) — ‘‘It is my opinion all of this will climax by or before the ending of the 90’s. We are entering the age of over population, the menace of crime and drug wars; starvation spreading over the planet! The time of depression and inflation and near the same time the approaching of peace and great prosperity; but in a new and revolutionary way! — This shall the people of the earth behold in an unusual way! — Also this age and the people will witness unbelievable inventions as they enter a world of fantasy and make-believe! A type of spirit like produces all of the Hollywood movies will seize the population into a dimension of unreality, as we see phantasm gripping the people everywhere finally into false worship! — concerning this and religion...’”

CONTINUING— “‘Already about 5 million people have visited Yugoslavia (town of Medjugorje) where in the virgin Mary, called the Madonna and our Lady has appeared they say, almost consistently for the last 5 years!’’ — ‘‘No doubt some are really seeing it, but again it is appearing in the wrong system! — So we see Satan’s illusions are appearing on various occasions worldwide! — And know this also Jesus is the one that is true and is exalted above all gods! (Ps. 97:9) And concerning mystery Babylon, vr.7 says, confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: (And David commanded) Worship Jesus, all ye gods!’’ — ‘‘plus every knee including Satan will bow in that day before the Most High God!

CONTINUING— “‘The world is entering the time of great quaking. Strange turbulence and volcanic eruptions are taking place under the sea. The Pacific and Atlantic plates are edging toward disaster! — It is my opinion at some point in the 90s parts of California will flip into the sea. — Also ominous signs are in the heavens, and huge asteroids are coming!’’ — ‘‘During this time a gigantic shifting of the land will take place. Millions will be swallowed up. We are entering a period of cosmic like storms that will sweep the planet. It will seem that all nature is turning against this world! Civilization will cave in under the push button atomic-chemical war!’’ ‘‘New energy inventions never seen before will be used. Even the colors of our world will change into terrifying colors of death, astonishment and plague! As the Pale horse of death finishes up and blend into the last apocalyptic events of the Lord. ‘‘During this time the earth will tumble, its axis will change!’’ — Ps. 97:3-5-A, fire goeth before him and burneth up his enemies round about! His lightnings enlightened the world the earth saw, and trembled! The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth! A day of reckoning is coming in our generation, this is written to tell the real people of the Lord to watch and pray!’’ — ‘‘This same Jesus will come! — Acts: sv

PROPHECY DECLARES IT SO— This was a statement of mother Shipton, who at the time some called a witch, but others said she was a reader of the Bible and had a very unusual gift. Known as the ancient forecaster of England!’’ — ‘‘She was able to see nearly 500 years in advance things occurring in our generation! — She saw perfectly the trends, and craze of men and women of our age, and the modern inventions!’’ — ‘‘Let us review a few things and touch on some that were overlooked by others!’’ — ‘‘She saw what was to take place in the very latter days.’’ — ‘‘A carriage without horse shall go-(car!)’’? — Disaster filled the world with woe! — World War I and II — Around the world men’s thoughts shall fly when pictures seem alive with movements free! — This is none other than radio, T.V. and satellite! She went on to reveal the submarine, the airships and etc.’’ — Then she said ‘‘water and fire’’ shall wonders do! How strange and yet it shall come true! — This concems the invention of electricity and atomic power that we have today!’’ — This ancient forecaster said, England and France shall be as one. And we have all heard over the News, that now at this time England is making a great tunnel under the sea to France, joining them together in trade, pleasure, business and tourism! This tunnel is supposed to cost about 3 or 4 billion dollars when finished.’’ — ‘‘Then the prophecy says, the British olive next shall twine in marriage with the Germany vine! Evidently this occurred when England and West Germany joined into the Common Market — This was called a unity in Marriage of the 10 Nations, a great trading block that the Bible itself predicted the Revived Roman Empire.’’ — ‘‘She said after this, the world would be drenched in blood! All of this was to occur in our 20th Century that we now live in!’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘We are absolutely entering the age of perilous times, the great falling away, not exactly from Church attendance, but from the Word and from the miraculous! — Only a few will want to hear sound doctrine! — An age where many have a form of godliness, but deny the real power! The age of diabolic scoffers.’’ — ‘‘In the 90s we will see a tremendous amount of rebellion among the youth, coupled with religious fanaticism in the wrong things!’’ — ‘‘The world will actually be upside down according to what is to be right! Watch, the anti-Christ who will be the master ‘‘piece’’ of Satan; at first will be manifested as a light angel! For Satan himself was transformed into an angel of light! (II Cor, 11:14) and later he will say to disobey God is to be more like God — The anti-Christ will use subtle snares in promoting evil to bring about supposed good! — In other words right is wrong and wrong is right as the hypnotic people follow his spell!’’ — “Most T.V. and Hollywood movies are preparing the masses for this now! Scores of Hollywood stars are joining the New age religion, the occult, some are even witches!...’’ ‘‘some of the Hollywood women believe in re-incarnation, Buda, the worship of crystals and images and the using of familiar spirits, as demon powers lead them into a dimension of voidness shrouded in falsehood!’’ — ‘‘We are entering the lurid 90s! — In this writing and the Scripts you have seen a picture of the future! In my opinion all the facts and evidently the signs indicate that by the year 2000 this old world will pass away into a new world, wherein Jesus shall be the King of it!”’

PROPHECY OF JOY!— ‘‘We know all the above is coming on the world, but to us it is a time of complete joy! We are entering the era of the miraculous and outpouring of the Lord to us! He will do great wonders and miracles for us! — In various places His cloud and pillar of fire will be seen as well as His presence. As a sign he is literally covering His pure elect with power and faith it will take to prepare for translation!’’ — ‘‘As we sing His praises and make a joyful sound we will be changed into His light! Our bodies will be as His! The Lord Himself shall descend. (I Thess. 4:16) As we unite in beautiful glorious light! Aren’t you glad to be one of His. Those who believe in all the Scriptures are definitely the children who go with Him! — Praise ye
